title: Jesse Marcel Library posts article about Greg Rogers
summary: Greg Rogers tells of Jesse Marcel Library posts article about Greg Rogers, about 2025 at Montana, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: One of the most interesting things was that I I recently found out that the Jesse Marcel Library in Montana >> has put up an article about me in their library.

plain: Greg Rogers, a man introduced as a NASA doctor who says he saw a UFO in a secret aircraft hangar, says he recently found out something interesting. According to Rogers, the Jesse Marcel Library in Montana, a library named after a man called Jesse Marcel, has put up an article about him in 2025. He tells it as a sign that his account is being taken seriously.
